motivation: The existing preservation label is a clipped ratio of a five-seed attacked-task posterior and a three-seed clean-task posterior. Low clean success makes that ratio noisy and removes 25-33 percent of attacked trajectories from preservation training in several folds. Model attacked BUP conditional on clean solvability instead of regressing the ratio.

data.clean_evidence_policy: The three clean trials are pre-attack task calibration and may be used as model context. No attacked validation or test outcomes may be used as features.

fixed_target_families.direct_probability: weighted ridge target is attacked-task Jeffreys posterior mean
fixed_target_families.uplift_probability: weighted ridge target is attacked-task posterior minus clean-task posterior
fixed_target_families.logit_residual: weighted ridge target is logit(attacked-task posterior) minus logit(clean-task posterior)

fixed_grid.attack_head: pairwise E5 plus structured ridge with alpha 10
fixed_grid.observation_weight: inverse delta-method posterior variance, clipped to the train 10th-90th percentile and normalized to mean one
fixed_grid.uncertainty: empirical Bayesian-ridge predictive standard deviation plus clean-posterior uncertainty

discovery.selection_constraint: validation selected target BUP must be no lower than the frozen joint-control target BUP
discovery.selection_objective: maximize validation target ASR plus BUP, then target BUP, mean within-task Spearman, lower normalized Brier, and fixed candidate order; metrics within 1e-12 are numerical ties
discovery.freeze: freeze the overall winner and the best candidate in each of the three target families before reading any test result

discovery_freeze.audit_note: An initial validation-only discovery used exact floating comparison and treated 1.0 as larger than 0.9999999999999999. Before any test access, metrics were rounded to 1e-12 for the preregistered tie-break and discovery was rerun. Both discovery archives are retained.

fixed_research_budget.reason: Use the cheap representation probe to reject weak target formulations before modifying Dreamer.

formal_primary: the overall fold-1-validation-selected candidate frozen before all outer-fold tests
secondary_counterevidence: the other two target-family winners are evaluated on the same five held-out folds but cannot replace the primary after test inspection
comparisons: formal frozen Dreamer OOF pct100 Top-1
frozen E5 plus structured pairwise joint-value OOF

posthoc_uncertainty_diagnostic.claim_boundary: held-out diagnostic only, not a replacement result
posthoc_uncertainty_diagnostic.finding: The validation-selected uncertainty penalty caused substantial ranking loss, but removing it still did not beat the frozen E5 joint baseline at 0.78.

causal_claim_boundary: The experiment borrows control-versus-treatment factorization from uplift modeling. It does not claim an identified causal effect because clean and attacked trajectories are separate stochastic executions and the primary objective is predictive candidate ranking.
